title: Test safety net for F2 skeleton (TDD, pulled from F10)
description: Pull forward the F10 test slice that covers the F2 cobra skeleton so F3 can be built test-first. Black-box cli.Run tests (exit codes + stream routing), --help golden, version.Get defaults, and a testscript E2E harness. Pure stdlib + testscript, no testify. Partially satisfies F10 (go_cli_tool_template-tnt).
close_reason: Test safety net landed: cli.Run contract tests, help golden, version guarantees, testscript E2E. Green under -race, cli 94.1% cov.

title: SKILL.md agent skill
description: The agent Skill runbook: collect inputs (module path, tool name, author, description), invoke cmd/scaffold, report results. Thin orchestration over the deterministic script. See ADR-0001/0003.

title: Release pipeline: GoReleaser + release workflow
description: .goreleaser.yaml + release.yml triggered on vX.Y.Z tag: cross-compiled archives, checksums, GitHub Releases, go install, Homebrew tap, cosign signing + SBOM. Container dropped; Scoop/nFPM deferred (separate beads). ldflags version injection.

title: CI workflow + Dependabot
description: .github/workflows/ci.yml: golangci-lint, go test -race -coverprofile, govulncheck, gofmt check; asymmetric matrix (full tests ubuntu x latest+previous Go; build-smoke macOS+Windows). Dependabot for modules + actions. Builds template/, examples/, root.
close_reason: Added .github/workflows/ci.yml (test: ubuntu x stable+oldstable, gofmt + go test -race -coverprofile per module; build-smoke: macOS+Windows; lint: golangci-lint v2 per module; govulncheck per module) + .github/dependabot.yml (gomod for all 3 modules + github-actions, weekly, grouped) + root .golangci.yml (default linters + std-error-handling exclusion preset). Each module built/tested standalone via GOWORK=off. Also migrated testscript RunMain->Main in template + example to drop a deprecated API flagged by staticcheck. Verified locally: gofmt clean, all modules lint-clean and pass -race (cov 72/92.8/92%), vet clean.

title: examples/yaml-validator: worked JSON Schema validator
description: Instantiate template + flesh out into a real YAML validator: validate subcommand, --schema flag, santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema (Draft 2020-12), structured violation paths showcasing human/JSON output + 0/1/2 exit codes. CI-built.
close_reason: Instantiated template/ via the scaffold into examples/yaml-validator and swapped the placeholder check domain for a real JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) YAML validator: internal/validate (santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema v6; YAML->JSON canonical decode; structured path-addressed violations) + validate subcommand with --schema, text/JSON output, and 0/1/2 exit codes. Added README, testscript, and unit/black-box tests; builds & tests standalone (GOWORK=off) and under -race.

title: cmd/scaffold: deterministic Go scaffold program
description: Self-contained Go program: copy template/, find/replace sentinel tokens (module path, tool/binary name, author, year, description), rename cmd/<tool> dir, run go mod tidy + git init. Owns all mechanical instantiation. Skill only collects inputs + invokes it. See ADR-0003.
close_reason: Implemented internal/scaffold: ordered sentinel replacement engine, Generate (tree copy + token substitution in content & paths, .git skip, empty-dest guard), Run CLI (flag parsing, required-flag/usage exit codes, go mod tidy + git init post-steps), and cmd/scaffold wiring. Tested: unit (replace/relDest/Generate/Run) + real-template integration proving standalone compile with zero surviving sentinels.

title: template: test suite (table + golden + testscript)
description: Demonstrate all three: table-driven core tests, golden-file output tests (testdata/*.golden with -update), and testscript .txtar E2E exercising the 0/1/2 exit-code contract. Pure stdlib, no testify.
notes: F7 check command tests landed (check pkg 87.5%; cli check command black-box valid/empty/stdin/json/missing/mixed + resolveInputNames white-box + check.txtar E2E). F10 test-suite goals now substantially met across all template packages; remaining F10 work is mainly consolidation/docs if desired.

title: template: validate-shaped placeholder command
description: Generic placeholder command that mirrors a validate verb: iterate input files (or stdin on - / pipe), per-item trivial pass/fail (e.g. non-empty/valid-UTF8), report human or JSON output, exit 0/1/2. No heavy deps. Designed so swapping in real domain logic is obvious.
close_reason: check command: internal/check placeholder domain (87.5%) + cli check subcommand (files/stdin, text+json, progress, slog, exit 0/1/2) wiring the full I/O contract. First real exit-1 path. TDD, green under -race (cli 97.2%).

title: template: I/O contract + global flag set + exit codes
description: stdout=data / stderr=logs discipline; exit-code mapping 0 valid / 1 invalid / 2 usage / >2 internal in the thin entrypoint; global flags --log-level (+--verbose/--debug aliases), -o/--output (json|text, TTY-aware), -q/--quiet, --no-color (+NO_COLOR), --config, --no-input, --version, -h. See ADR-0002.
notes: F2 note: cobra auto-binds -v to --version. The global flag set needs -v for --verbose (alias of --log-level). F3 must reclaim -v: register the persistent verbose flag and override/clear cobra's version shorthand (e.g. set a custom version flag without -v, or use cmd.InitDefaultVersionFlag then re-point). Verify no shorthand collision.
close_reason: Global flag set + reclaimed -v + validate() usage errors + EffectiveLogLevel resolution + typed validation/internal exit codes (1/3). TDD, green under -race, cli 98.2% cov. Downstream wiring deferred to F4/F6/F7 per scope boundary.

title: template: cobra skeleton + thin main + internal/version
description: Cobra root command, thin cmd/<tool>/main.go that only wires + maps exit codes, and internal/version with ldflags vars plus runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo() fallback exposed via --version. Pin cobra v1.10.2. See ADR-0004.
close_reason: Cobra root command (SilenceErrors/Usage, NoArgs), thin main delegating to cli.Run, internal/version with ldflags+ReadBuildInfo fallback. --version/--help work; exit codes 0/2 verified on built binary. cobra v1.10.2/pflag v1.0.9 pinned. -v/verbose conflict noted on F3 (-ceg).

title: Repo module/workspace layout
description: Establish go.work workspace: root module hosting cmd/scaffold; template/ as its own self-contained module; examples/yaml-validator/ as its own module. Foundation that everything else builds on. See ADR-0001/0003.
close_reason: go.work workspace with three standalone-buildable modules (root/cmd/scaffold, template/ with sentinel path, examples/yaml-validator); all build+vet green, tree clean.

title: EPIC: Build the Go CLI tool template (v1)
description: Stand up the full deliverable: a compilable, CI-tested generic Template (cobra+pflag+fang), a deterministic Go scaffold program, a worked yaml-validator example, CI/release pipelines, community health files, the agent Skill, and docs Guides. Decisions captured in docs/adr/0001-0004 and CONTEXT.md.

title: Deep research: choose CLI framework for the Template
description: The Template's base CLI framework is deliberately deferred from the design/grilling session to a dedicated deep-research session. Evaluate cobra(+pflag), urfave/cli, alecthomas/kong, and stdlib flag; plus add-ons charmbracelet/fang and spf13/viper. Decide base + whether to include fang/viper. Output should be an ADR. Everything downstream (project layout, flag wiring, help/completions) depends on this.
close_reason: Resolved by deep-research session; outcome recorded in ADR-0004 (cobra+pflag base, fang isolated add-on, viper excluded).

title: template: ship a single-module ci.yml for scaffolded projects
description: The repo's .github/workflows/ci.yml is multi-module (root+template+example, GOWORK=off) and stays at repo root, so it is NOT copied by the scaffold. Generated projects currently get a release workflow (template/.github/workflows/release.yml, from F15) but no CI. Add template/.github/workflows/ci.yml — a simpler single-module workflow (gofmt, go test -race -cover, golangci-lint, govulncheck) — so scaffolded projects are CI-ready out of the box. Surfaced while doing F15.

title: docs/guides

title: cmd/scaffold: golden-file tests
description: Golden-file tests asserting scaffold output for a fixed input set, so instantiation is verifiable and regression-safe.

title: template: completions + per-subcommand man pages
description: Wire cobra built-in completions (bash/zsh/fish/powershell) and per-subcommand man pages via cobra/doc.GenManTree (go-md2man). Avoid hyphenated-name .1 filename ambiguity. Packaged later by GoReleaser.

title: template: fang integration behind isolated seam
description: Wrap cobra Execute with charmbracelet/fang (v2.0.1, pinned) for styled help/usage/errors, isolated behind a single swappable wrapper so plain cobra.Execute() can replace it. NOT load-bearing. Man pages NOT via fang. See ADR-0004.

title: template: config loader
description: internal/config loader with precedence flags > env (TOOL_* prefix) > YAML file > defaults; discovery at XDG config dir + project-local ./.<tool>.yaml; --config overrides. gopkg.in/yaml.v3, no viper. See ADR (config) + 0004.
close_reason: config loader: internal/config (88.9%) defaults<file<env precedence + XDG/project discovery + explicit-missing/malformed errors; cli integration applyConfig completing flags>env>file>defaults. TDD, green under -race.

title: template: Progress interface + bar + no-op
description: Small Progress interface (Start/Add/Finish); lightweight bar/spinner default (schollz/progressbar v3); no-op implementation auto-selected under non-TTY / --quiet / --no-input. Always writes to stderr.
close_reason: progress: internal/progress (100%) Tracker + bar + no-op; cli progressEnabled resolution + newProgress auto-silent off-TTY/quiet/no-input. TDD, green under -race.

title: template: slog + tint logging, --log-format auto
description: stdlib log/slog as the interface; colorized console handler on stderr via lmittmann/tint (respects --no-color/NO_COLOR), slog.JSONHandler when machine-readable; --log-format text|json defaulting to auto-detect (console on TTY, JSON off-TTY). Level driven by --log-level.
close_reason: slog+tint logging: internal/logging (100% cov) with JSON/console/auto handlers + ParseLevel; cli wiring (--log-format, TTY/color resolution, context logger via loggerFrom). TDD, green under -race.

title: Future: CI scaffold-drift check for examples/yaml-validator
description: examples/yaml-validator is a hand-maintained instantiation of template/ and can drift as the Template evolves. Add a CI check that re-runs the scaffold script against template/ and diffs the non-domain files (everything except the validator's domain logic) against the committed example, failing if they diverge. Keeps the worked example honest.
